title: Registration
description: User registration system of Rozgar Connect

fields.name: email
fields.validation: Must be a valid and unique email address format, saved in lowercase

fields.name: password
fields.validation: Must be at least 6 characters long

customer.database_actions: A new User document is created in the database. Password is automatically hashed using bcrypt with salt 12.
customer.session_generation: An Access Token and Refresh Token are generated for the session. The Refresh Token is saved to the User document and sent as an HTTP-only cookie to the client.
customer.client_response: Returns the registered user object, access token, and logs the user directly into the customer home dashboard.

worker.explanation: Workers are automatically granted the 'customer' role so they can browse other services and perform customer-specific workflows without creating a separate account.
worker.database_actions: A new User document is created with roles 'worker' and 'customer'. Password is encrypted via bcrypt.
worker.session_generation: An Access Token and Refresh Token are generated and saved.
worker.client_response: Returns user object, access token, and a flag 'redirectToSetup: true'. This instructs the frontend to redirect the worker immediately to the Worker Profile Setup page ('/worker-setup') to complete their registration.

notes: Database validations are implemented using Express Validator on the API route and Mongoose schema level.
